capabilities: Add inline tooltips with Markdown formatting
Define synonyms that share a tooltip
Search dictionary entries by word or synonym
Wrap a selection via editor command
extras: Inline tooltips use a custom {/{ / }/} delimiter syntax, and keyboard shortcuts for the inline command are assigned through Obsidian's Hotkeys settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach definitions or descriptions to specific words that appear on hover.
summary: Tooltip plugin that adds hover descriptions to words and phrases, using inline syntax or note- and folder-scoped dictionaries.
